body.text:
Move canonical source and issue tracking to https://tangled.org/samclemente.me/the-social-wire while retaining existing Vercel projects/domains, Turso databases, Blob objects and encryption keys.

Decisions:
- Direct deployment from Tangled CI; no GitHub deployment mirror.
- Deployment credentials remain in the application repository, with Tangled's documented same-repository workflow secret visibility understood.
- Scope now: Web and Go backend. iOS will use Xcode Cloud later; no Namespace activation.
- L@tr provisioning remains explicitly on hold; do not rotate or reconfigure it.

Work:
- Snapshot GitHub/Tangled refs; fast-forward existing Tangled main/dev without deleting historical branches; set Tangled as local origin and retain GitHub archive remote.
- Export/import all open+closed GitHub issues, comments and labels with original authors/dates/URLs in provenance and an idempotent source-to-target map. Preserve unsupported metadata in the archive.
- Run Web coverage/spec/type/lint/image and Go vet/tests/image verification on Spindle. Bind results to exact commit; enforce Development-before-Production parity.
- Gate Vercel CLI release on all required exact-commit Tangled checks; preserve environment isolation and the current two-project topology until #992's separate cutover is accepted.
- Verify Tangled runs and direct Development deployment before disabling GitHub CI/deployment integration. Keep existing deployments serving until replacement acceptance.

Initial inventory: 354 issues (55 open), 730 comments,17 labels; Tangled main/dev are stale ancestors of current GitHub releases. Issue import planning and Linux workflow implementation are in progress. Existing live deployments and storage remain unchanged.
